notes.title: Experience Spirit Mancer Anywhere with Steam Remote Play!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/9d059c8b85b59473fc4cb26e8a37d5aeb5cd0afc.png[/img]

We’re happy to announce that [b]Spirit Mancer[/b] supports [b]Steam Remote Play[/b], bringing a whole new level of multiplayer fun to the game! You can now [b]team up with friends[/b] and dive into the Inferno together, no matter where you are.

[b]What is Steam Remote Play?[/b]  🕹️
Steam Remote Play allows you to stream Spirit Mancer to any device, meaning your friends can join your game even if they’re not on the same network. No more worrying about being in the same room or location, just connect and play!

[b]How Does It Work?[/b] 🕹️
[list]
[*] [b]Invite Friends[/b]: Easily send invites through Steam and have friends join your game, even if they don’t have the game installed.
[*] [b]Play Anywhere[/b]: Whether it’s on a PC or Steam Deck, everyone can join in on the adventure.
[/list]
This new feature makes it easier than ever to explore the world of Spirit Mancer with friends, no matter where they are. We hope you enjoy the new way to play and [b]stay tuned for more exciting updates[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172580/Spirit_Mancer/

notes.title: The side-scrolling action demon-catching game Spirit Mancer is at SNF!
notes.notes:
[u][b]The free demo of Spirit Mancer is now available at the Steam Next Fest! [/b][/u]You can try it for free or add it to your wishlist. You can also pre-order the game in advance—[b]get a 10% discount and receive the exclusive IFN66 card deck to fill the Inferno with cute dances![/b]

Pre-order the Deluxe Edition for even more, including the Tarot Spirit card deck, Ancient Dragon Soul card deck, digital soundtrack, and digital artbook.

We regret to inform you that due to a large number of player-reported bugs in the demo and necessary optimizations, the official release of the game has been postponed to November 22, 2024. We are currently working with Steam to update the store page release date.

Spirit Mancer Steam demo/pre-order link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2172580/_/


Spirit Mancer is a side-scrolling action-adventure game with card-based demon-catching mechanics. You can seal any monsters you encounter into cards and use them to fight for you, or wield various elemental weapons like daggers, guns, or knuckles to enjoy the thrilling combat experience of slashing and shooting. You can also team up with friends to battle the demon horde and stop the evil queen’s sinister plot!

notes.title: Play the demo during Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hey, Spirit Mancers!

The Steam Next Fest is opening today and we're so excited to be part of this big event!! Try the demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187350/Spirit_Mancer_Demo/

Here are [b]five exciting things[/b] you should know about our game, Spirit Mancer:

[h2]1. Unique Gameplay Featuring Action & Deckbuilding[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/6b9f10445e63fddf198355e69dd4679754e1437c.gif[/img]
Spirit Mancer combines Hack and Slash action with strategic deck-building. Capture demon spirits and summon them into battle, using their unique abilities to overcome challenging enemies.

[h2]2. Vibrant 2D World[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/c679b331de091036b4f814f8e04e1bbfcf291fa0.gif[/img]
The game features a beautiful pixel art style with vibrant biomes to explore, from lush forests to volcanic fortresses. Each area is filled with danger, adventure, and plenty of demons to capture!

[h2]3. JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Inspiration[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/b6b1b5893aa6eb05913d224abd850a9e9c54b341.gif[/img]
Our team has drawn significant inspiration from JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure! You’ll find numerous references throughout the game, adding a unique flair and charm to your experience.

[h2]4. Meet the Anans[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/61a32a002a26c6b0471f97e683c92c03d33f31ea.gif[/img]
Anans are low-level demons scattered across the Inferno. They may not have special powers, but they are incredibly adaptable and quick learners. Though somewhat naive, they can survive anywhere in the Inferno and are excellent at following instructions, making them perfect assistants for our heroes. With the right guidance, they can help you build, fight, and explore!

[h2]5. Built by a Passionate Team[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/3bfbb753455715b33dd06b2c3b280bc1850f0a8d.gif[/img]
Spirit Mancer is crafted by a team of passionate developers at Sunny Syrup Studio, dedicated to delivering a memorable adventure with stunning art, engaging gameplay, and a world filled with secrets to uncover.

Stay tuned for more updates and join us in the world of Spirit Mancer!

– The Sunny Syrup Studio Team 🌟


And don't forget to share your review with us! 

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 🤣 Huh? Spirit Mancer has a publisher? 🤣
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/16fe2dd44841e9cef2d0a39b63f89ccac038543f.png[/img]

Hi all, 

We, Dear Villagers, an indie game publisher in the south of France, are super excited to team up with Sunny Syrup Studio!

[previewyoutube=yyiH2azmmjg;full][/previewyoutube]
Instead of just saying Spirit Mancer is a 2D action side-scroller with deck-building, blah blah blah, let us break it down for you in a few sentences... 😎

[h3]😉 A UNIQUE HACK N'SLASH 😉[/h3]
Slash, shoot, and smash demons! (Personally, I prefer slashing them) You can even collect and summon them during combat! We've got a variety of monsters, guns, and weapons for you to choose from!

Wanna double the excitement? Invite a friend and play in Co-op mode!

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/5e5a658e5c73703310904b9fa84b7cd7e5430308.gif[/img][/th]
        [th][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43051906/62c0a75335aa74457a61e0c4d1e5d37b22fb788c.gif[/img][/th]
    [/tr]
[/table]
